name: stage118-juicity-h3-loopback-gate
gate_decision: stage118 admits only the local Juicity H3 loopback smoke: quinn/h3/h3-quinn/tokio execute a rootless TLS1.3+h3 request-response loopback and the rustls certificate callback is observed; pinned certchain verification, DialAuth, packet conn, congestion, quic_h3_family/outbound/default/product switches remain closed

rows.evidence: Stage118 smoke creates a local quinn endpoint pair, negotiates TLS1.3+h3, and echoes HTTP/3 request/response payload through h3-quinn
rows.boundary: local H3 request-response is not Juicity DialAuth or packet relay
rows.next_action: wire Juicity DialAuth over the established H3 session

rows.evidence: Stage118 custom rustls verifier records the raw cert chain DER count and cert-chain hash during the loopback handshake
rows.boundary: callback observation is not pinned_certchain_sha256 verification parity
rows.next_action: feed the callback chain into the Stage115 pinned certchain verifier in a live H3 gate

rows.evidence: Stage118 loopback config records TLS1.3, ALPN h3, datagram disabled, keepalive 5s, and handshake idle timeout 8s
rows.boundary: transport constants do not admit congestion or packet relay behavior
rows.next_action: carry constants into DialAuth and packet conn gates

rows.evidence: UDP port 0 DialAuth TransportPacketConn, stream_packet_conn for nonzero UDP, packet-over-stream, and congestion behavior still require Juicity protocol state
rows.next_action: implement DialAuth/packet conn gates after live certchain verifier wiring

rows.evidence: Juicity true dataplane, Hysteria2/TUIC true QUIC, outbound registry/group/health, matched default daemon benchmark, and product-chain recertification remain open
rows.boundary: local loopback smoke does not admit outbound_true_dataplane_admitted=true
rows.next_action: continue Juicity H3 gates before outbound-wide recertification
